text: COSTUME_SILLA_LABORER_A01: Silla labourer (PROBABLE, CLM_SILLA_COSTUME_001-007): undyed coarse hemp plain-weave; short narrow-sleeved jacket to hip length, straight collar closing right over left; narrow trousers, possibly bound at shin or ankle; plain cloth waist cord, no metal; straw sandals or bare feet; topknot with a cloth band or bare topknot, may be bare-chested while working; colours natural white, black or raw fibre, no bright dye. Dust, sweat, worn cloth. Forbidden: Joseon hanbok silhouette, gat hat, Ming/Qing dress, samurai elements, modern fabric, purple/crimson/blue/yellow official colours.
